scope: Dijkstra's BBODY, UTXOW (with UTXO and UTXOS), ENTITIES, CERTS (with Dijkstra's CERT, POOL and GOVCERT) and GOV of the Leios testnet build, each applied on its own with every check run: BBODY over the devnet's Dijkstra blocks, UTXOW over the devnet transaction and its variants, CERTS on the default certificate state, GOV after a CERTS setup on the default store of proposals, pools' votes on parameter changes of keys 34 to 56, ill-formed parameter changes and the bootstrap phase's refusals among them, pool registrations with voting keys, ENTITIES over a transaction's withdrawals, direct deposits, balance intervals and certificates; not LEDGER on its own or the SUB rules
